newsitem.title: USA: Carrington Labs says CFO resigns.
newsitem.headline: Carrington Labs says CFO resigns.

text.p: Carrington Laboratories Inc said on Tuesday that Sheri Pantermuehl, its chief financial officer and treasurer, resigned to pursue other business opportunities.
The company said no replacement was named to take Pantermuehl's place. "The company will evaluate its needs and begin a search as appropriate," it said in a statement.
Pantermuehl had been with the company for three years, serving as controller from June 1994 until October 1995 when she became CFO and treasurer.
Carrington is a research-based pharmaceutical and medical device company.
